answers.reason: Expanded/collapsed state is indicated by chevron icon direction (up/down), not color alone.
Focus rings are clear blue borders with strong contrast on light and dark backgrounds. Control boundaries and chevron icons are clearly distinguishable.
Visible text 'Shipping details' matches the announced screen reader name. Open By Default story includes expanded content in the announcement.
All text is fully visible, including the content in Open By Default story ('Orders ship within 3-5 business days. Express shipping is available at checkout.'). No truncation or overlap.
Default and Open By Default focused screenshots show prominent blue border focus indicators that are immediately obvious.
